title: Computation by the Canonical Block Tree
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on $n$ sign variables, and let $\rho$ assign to each coordinate one of three states: free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. The decision tree obtained by the canonical block-tree construction from $\varphi$ and $\rho$ computes the function that evaluates $\varphi$ after completing each free coordinate from a Boolean input and setting each fixed coordinate to its prescribed sign.
hypotheses_covered: A disjunctive normal form on $n$ sign variables
A coordinate restriction assigning each coordinate a free or fixed state
